static_traits.name: 王佩琪
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友，但尚not yet与其讨论这些具体想法；与潜在伴侣的关系受自尊问题影响；工作表现not yet受影响

basic_info.main_problem: 我相信do not人觉得我not漂亮，这影响了我的自尊与自信，尤其是在寻找结婚伴侣的过程中；我常常Self-doubt并感到自己not具吸引力，主要在社交或初次见面时出现。
basic_info.core_demands: 'I am willing to do anything to make myself feel better and boost my confidence.'

special_situations.event: 在社交场合或与陌生人初次见面时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我外表not够漂亮，do not人就会not愿与我交谈或发展关系
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Enhances confidence through makeup and styling; over-invests in appearance management before going out
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这里的人大概都觉得我not好看，not想和我说话

special_situations.event: 开始主动寻找结婚伴侣的阶段
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人根据外貌评判我并觉得我not漂亮，我就without法找到伴侣

special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会根据外貌来判断我，觉得我not够漂亮

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我得到的关注少，就证明我not漂亮、not如do not人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifies self-criticism and invests further in appearance grooming to 'catch up' with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as others漂亮

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not够漂亮，就not会被选为伴侣并可能遭到拒绝

special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他大概not会对我有兴趣，因为我not好看

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and appreciated and to build a stable intimate relationship with a partner
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因外貌被评判与拒绝，体验羞耻与not被选择的痛苦

Avoids revealing true thoughts to friends to reduce the possibility of being judged

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others invite her to share shameful thoughts related to appearance, or when she feels watched and compared in social settings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识将他人视为评判者，认为对方会觉得自己浅薄或not好看（移情：他人=批判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和、接纳的语气，先Empathy其羞耻与担忧，再以开放式问题引导其具体化证据与体验；避免评判与过度解释，保持节奏缓慢与安全感的建立。

outcomes: 对外貌的过度投入与时间消耗

Spending excessive time on grooming before going out to ensure being 'up to standard'

target_behavior.function: 寻求外部认可、暂时降低Being rejected的恐惧
target_behavior.consequence: Disrupts daily routines, consumes time and energy, still hard to stably raise self-esteem
